finalists.label: Lipodermatosclerosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including progressive unilateral skin hardening and slight thickening of subcutaneous tissue.

finalists.label: Fibromatosis
finalists.why: It has a strong for evidence, including progressive unilateral skin hardening and increased expression of CD34 in the reticular dermis.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has more specific for evidence, including ill-defined, stony-hard plaque and loss of skin elasticity, which are not fully explained by the runner-up.
